articles.title: Lindsey Graham eulogized as an 'American original' at services drawing world leaders in Washington
articles.original_title: Lindsey Graham eulogized as an 'American original' at services drawing world leaders in Washington
articles.description: Sen. Lindsey Graham is being eulogized in Washington. Graham’s flag-draped casket arrived Tuesday at the U.S. Capitol, where the Republican served for more than 30 years as an indefatigable dealmaker. Vice President JD Vance calls Graham a “swashbuckling” character and a “true American original.” Senate Majority Leader John Thune says Graham was “a towering figure.” Guests were arriving in the afternoon for a funeral at Washington National Cathedral. President Donald Trump is expected to deliver remarks at the cathedral ceremony. Israel’s Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukraine’s Volodymyr Zelenskyy are attending. It’s the start of two days of services for Graham, with burial Wednesday in his home state of South Carolina. He died July 11 at age 71.

articles.title: India's growing Rs 100 crore club tells a bigger tax story
articles.original_title: India's growing Rs 100 crore club tells a bigger tax story
articles.description: More than five hundred taxpayers disclosed incomes exceeding one hundred crore rupees for the current fiscal year. This growth reflects rising incomes among the wealthiest individuals and a more transparent tax system. Increased tax filings also show progress in tax administration, though many still pay no tax. The formalization of the economy and access to capital are key drivers of this positive trend.
